hero.subtitle: 使当前与未来的商店随从成长。

semantics.offers: Permanent tavern attack/health apply to current and future offers; freeze and continuation never double-apply. Fresh refill only.
semantics.purchase: Keep actual card stats; future growth does not change bought cards. Triples sum earned stats.
semantics.exclusions: Discoveries, generated cards and combat summons receive no tavern growth.
semantics.consume: Remove one real offer, no coins/hand/copy/keyword/death/battlecry/sell triggers; no double consumption. Blood harm resolves before food stats are read.
semantics.counter: New offer base bonus is not a new royal buff event; growing current offers counts actual recipient buffs.
semantics.migration: Old history starts at zero, existing card stats retained.

verification.browser: Drag purchase/spell; current/future growth; freeze/reload; visible consumed art/stats; twelve normal/golden cards; desktop and 360/390 px; fully offline.
verification.followup: Additional focused tests verify low-health feast budget and non-target spell drag excludes target-only synergies.

benchmark: market-after.json: four seeds, 16 real recruitment routes, no PvP eliminations; diagnostic, not live win rates.
